datasets.title: British Virgin Islands Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 10.6 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 77% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 3 years ( Last edited 4 months ago ) and 1% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['building'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en building building:levels building:materials addr:full addr:housenumber addr:street addr:city office source This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for British Virgin Islands through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) Raw Data API. The dataset represents approximately 77% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 3 years and continuous updates from the OSM community.
